name: Lawrence Open 2014

venue.name: [Lawrence High School](http://lhs.usd497.org/)
venue.details: Through the school's front entrance, take an immediate right after entering the school.

information: If you register and pay the fees online, it will cost $5 to enter and $2 for each event. If you pay at the door, it will cost $10 to enter and $2 for each event, and you may only enter in 2x2, 3x3, OH, 4x4, Pyraminx, and Skewb. Please have exact change.
